facts.statement: IIR identifies current highest priority pending interrupt type with priority source and reset control.
facts.quote:
The IIR enables the programmer to retrieve what is the current highest priority pending
interrupt.

facts.statement: IIR Bit 0 low indicates interrupt pending and high indicates no interrupt pending.
facts.quote: Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’.

facts.statement: Receiver Line Status pending from parity overrun framing or break is cleared by reading Line Status Register.
facts.quote:
Parity, Overrun or Framing
errors or Break Interrupt
Reading the Line
Status Register

facts.statement: Modem Status pending from CTS DSR RI or DCD is cleared by reading Modem status register.
facts.quote:
0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem
status register.

facts.statement: IER allows enabling and disabling UART interrupt generation.
facts.quote: This register allows enabling and disabling interrupt generation by the UART.

facts.statement: IER bit 0 is Received Data available interrupt.
IER bit 1 is Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt.
facts.quote: 1 RW Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt

facts.statement: IER bit 2 is Receiver Line Status Interrupt.
IER bit 3 is Modem Status Interrupt.
Framing error means top FIFO character lacked valid stop bit.
facts.quote:
The received character at the top of the FIFO did not
have a valid stop bit.
